positive.point: Starting a cleaning business is considered a solid first business due to low startup costs and real recurring demand.
Unlimited memberships can create a sense of belonging and commitment among members, leading to better retention.
A sliding scale pricing model can help balance fairness and compensation, allowing for pro bono work while maintaining revenue.
Focusing on niche services like curb appeal refreshes in landscaping can be a viable business model with potentially high returns.

negative.point: The cleaning business is highly competitive, with many entrants competing on price, leading to burnout.
Unlimited memberships can lead to decreased revenue per member if not priced correctly, as they may turn into discount programs.
Pricing cleaning jobs based solely on square footage can lead to underquoting, especially if not considering other factors like condition and travel.
Starting a dumpster rental business can be challenging due to customer acquisition, insurance, and regulatory hurdles.
